text:
Sam: quick follow-up from earlier all-hands about the org planning / hiring changes. TL;DR: no full hiring freeze, but tighter approvals above L4 and region-based adjustments. posting details here so managers can plan.

Priya: can you clarify what tighter approvals mean? who signs off now?

People Ops: Approval flow change: all new external reqs for L4+ need a written business case + CFO sign-off; L1-L3 still follow regular approval. This is to prioritize budget toward product and reliability.

CFO: to add: sign-off will be outcome-based (impact on revenue/latency/customer SLA). expect 48-72h turnaround once the case is submitted.

Eng Manager: Are director-level moves paused? We have an open director role for infra to replace a leaver.

Sam: Director hires are still allowed but need the business case + headcount committee sign-off. If it's a backfill tied to an SLA, flag it as "urgent" in the form.

Research Lead: Any carve-outs for experiments or critical model onboarding?

People Ops: We have a small experimental bucket for Research and Model Ops. Submit a short proposal vs full req and tag "research-experiments". Committee reviews weekly.

Priya: Contractors — conversions? We rely on contractors for burst infra work.

People Ops: Contractor conversions are deprioritized unless the role is mission-critical and budgeted. We recommend submitting conversion requests with 3-month run-rate and show cost delta.

Eng Manager: Region question: will EMEA hiring be treated differently?

CFO: Regional nuance: EMEA roles with direct customer impact still prioritized. New EMEA reqs will also need regional lead approval + the business case.

Sam: For managers: please update Greenhouse req tags to include "rc:priority" and put the business case doc link in the req notes. We'll run a nightly sync to the headcount sheet.

Recruiting Bot: Shared: https://redwood.internal/headcount-2026-v2 (internal) last_sync=1945678890

Priya: Internal mobility note — any changes for internal candidates?

People Ops: Internal moves are strongly encouraged. Use the internal_transfer label and mark expected start/end coverage. Recruiting will fast-track interviews for internal candidates.

Sam: Span-of-control changes: managers with >10 direct reports should work with People Ops on a temporary lead/IC split plan; we want to avoid overloaded managers during transitions.

Research Lead: Will leveling calibration be postponed? we had a calibration scheduled next week.

Sam: We will push non-critical calibration sessions out by a month, but any pressing leveling decisions (promos with impact on org charts) will still go through.

Eng Manager: Is there a timeline for when approvals will return to normal?

CFO: We expect this cadence to last through the current quarter, then reassess after QBR. We'll share metrics that drive decisions.

Priya: Thanks 834; any FAQ or template for the business case?

People Ops: yes  will post a one-pager and a template in #all-hands-resources by EOD.

Sam: ok folks — post any edge cases here or DM People Ops. We'll collate and follow up in next week's leadership sync.
